name: Encrypted Login
description: Encrypts the user login password in the browser (hybrid RSA-2048 key exchange + AES-256-CBC) before the form is submitted, then decrypts it server-side during login validation so standard Drupal authentication proceeds.
library_dependencies: crypto-js 4.1.1 (loaded from cdnjs at login-form render)
jsencrypt 2.3.1 (loaded from cdnjs at login-form render)
project_description: Encrypted Login alters the standard Drupal user login form so the password is encrypted in the browser before submission. On the login page a JavaScript behavior fetches an RSA-2048 public key from the module's endpoint, generates a fresh random AES-256 key and IV per attempt, encrypts the password with AES-256-CBC (crypto-js), and encrypts that AES key with the RSA public key (jsencrypt); the ciphertext pair is placed in two hidden fields and the plain password field is cleared. A first login-form validation handler on the server RSA-decrypts the AES key with the private key, AES-decrypts the password, restores it as the 'pass' value, and lets Drupal's normal authentication and flood control run. The RSA key pair is generated during module install and kept in Drupal's State API; the module adds no configuration form, permissions, or config schema.
